text:
Maya: Heads up  Kestrel (prospect) wants a pilot: tenant-isolated capacity, customer-managed KMS, and aggressive latency goals. Need scope + launch criteria callouts.
Priya: Do they require HSM day one?
Maya: Prefer HSM eventually but OK with customer KMS for pilot if we provide audit logs and a migration path. Pilot ask: p95 <= 200ms for 2k-token gen.
Alex: Infra: dedicated pool + VPC peering doable. HSM attestation + key escrow flows are separate and ~3w. KMS connector + audit pipeline = ~8 working days.
Sam: Runtime: hitting p95 200ms at 2k tokens is achievable with tuned model variant + quantization + warmed KV cache. p99 150ms is not feasible now. Need perf matrix.
Jordan: Security: we can provide audit exports for customer-managed KMS, but mustn't advertise HSM equivalence. Compliance docs will take a sprint.
Lee: Product proposal: MVP pilot = customer-managed KMS, dedicated capacity, soft SLA (p95 target), eval harness + rollback plan. Post-pilot: HSM + tightened SLOs.
Priya: Customer wants pilot in ~8 weeks. If we parallelize infra/runtime/security work, pilot seems possible without HSM. I'll push for a capacity commitment.
Sam: I'll run latency matrix (seq 512/1024/2048), quant A/B, and cache warmup tests. ETA: 10 business days.
Alex: I'll open infra tickets for peering, pool provisioning, KMS connector, and audit logs. Will drop the runbook link here.
Jordan: I'll deliver a compliance-gap note and legal wording about key custody claims by EOW next week.
Maya: Action recap: Maya -> finalize acceptance language with Legal; Priya -> customer SOW & negotiation; Alex -> infra tickets & runbook; Sam -> runtime perf tests; Jordan -> compliance doc; Lee -> evals.
deploy-bot: Ticket PROD-9123 created: "Kestrel pilot preflight" assigned to Alex.
Maya: I'll collate a short acceptance checklist. Proposing: 1) p95 <= 200ms under pilot traffic; 2) quality delta <= 2% on eval suite; 3) audit logs available; 4) infra runbook green. Agree?
Lee: +1. I'll run the evals when Sam posts results.
Maya: Weekly checkpoint next Tue. I'll post the formal acceptance criteria once Legal signs off.
